# MetaDialog

> > MetaDialog provides secure, multilingual AI-powered customer support automation with custom language models and enterprise integrations.

MetaDialog specializes in generative AI solutions for customer service, offering both SMB and enterprise platforms with integrations to Zendesk, Intercom, and LiveChat. The company emphasizes data privacy through on-premises deployment options and custom language models tailored to specific industries and regions.

## Key Topics

- Customer Support Automation
- Generative AI
- Large Language Models (LLMs)
- Custom Language Models
- Data Privacy
- On-Premises Deployment
- Multilingual Support
- Zendesk Integration
- Intercom Integration
- Enterprise AI
- Conversational AI
- Compliance
- Semantic Search
- Knowledge Management
- CRM Integration

## Core Platforms

- [AI for Small, Medium and Large Businesses](https://www.metadialog.com/smb-ai-support-platform): MetaDialog's secure multilingual AI support platform for SMBs with Zendesk integration.
- [Enterprise AI Support Platform](https://www.metadialog.com/enterprise-ai-support-platform): Enterprise-grade generative AI support automation with Zendesk and Intercom integration.
- [AI for Customer Service](https://www.metadialog.com/customer-support): MetaDialog conversational AI for omnichannel customer service and CRM integration.

## Custom AI & Language Models

- [Custom Language Models](https://www.metadialog.com/custom-language-models): Custom on-premises language models with data privacy and semantic search capabilities.
- [Chatbot API Integrations](https://www.metadialog.com/integrations): API integrations for Zendesk, Intercom, LiveChat and omnichannel support platforms.

## Industry Solutions

- [AI in Government](https://www.metadialog.com/governments): Secure compliant LLMs for government agencies with on-premises deployment options.
- [AI for Finance](https://www.metadialog.com/finance): Proprietary AI for finance with fraud detection and compliance without data leakage.
- [AI in Retail](https://www.metadialog.com/retail): Custom LLM for retail with product recommendations and inventory management.
- [AI for Healthcare](https://www.metadialog.com/healthcare): Custom secure on-premise LLMs for healthcare patient interaction and triage.
- [AI for SaaS](https://www.metadialog.com/saas): Private custom-built AI for SaaS companies with knowledge management and analytics.
